+++ b/tests/test_response_dependency.py
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+from typing import Annotated
+
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Response
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+async def modify_response(response: Response):
+    response.headers["X-Modified"] = "true"
+    return response
+
+
+@app.get("/annotated")
+async def annotated_endpoint(
+    response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)],
+):
+    return {"msg": "Hello World"}
+
+
+@app.get("/default")
+async def default_endpoint(
+    response: Response = Depends(modify_response),
+):
+    return {"msg": "Hello World"}
+
+
+@app.get("/regular")
+async def regular_endpoint(response: Response):
+    response.headers["X-Regular"] = "true"
+    return {"msg": "Hello World"}
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_annotated():
+    response = client.get("/annotated")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"msg": "Hello World"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Modified"] == "true"
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_default():
+    response = client.get("/default")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"msg": "Hello World"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Modified"] == "true"
+
+
+def test_response_regular_injection():
+    response = client.get("/regular")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"msg": "Hello World"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Regular"] == "true"
